messages:
Incident Bot: Pager received for service 'generation' — severity: S2. Short description: high p99 latency in us-west cluster. Pager -> @Alex
Alex: Acked. Oncall looking.
Alex: seeing elevated p99 (12s) and error spike ~1.2% starting 06:14 UTC. Rolling autoscaler logs show repeated node churn.
Sanjay: I'm on it — looks like autoscaler oscillation after a bad node health check. Triggered burst provision but pods not warming. Investigating kernel OOM logs on g4d nodes.
Maya (oncall): Quick mitigation: disabling autoscaler and scaling up pool by +2 nodes. Also switch routing to model-small for non-critical customers (canary) to shed load.
Alex: Doing the scale up now. Will apply temporary routing policy.
Ryan (eng): Suggested config snippet to force model fallback:
```
route.policy := {
  if latency > 1000ms then fallback_to: "text-smaller-v1"
}
```
Alex: Applied. p99 dropped to ~3.6s. Errors down to 0.3%.
Incident Bot: Draft status page update queued — needs confirmation from incident lead.
Lucy (support): Need language for customer notification and to start SLA eligibility triage. Which accounts hit the threshold?
Alex: Early list from the request logs: 13 accounts with sustained requests during the window 06:14–06:28 UTC. Biggest impacted: acct-772, acct-19 (high QPS). We'll need per-account request counts + tokens to estimate compensation.
Sanjay: I can export request logs and token counts. ETA 25m.
Lucy (support): Thanks. I'll prepare a preliminary customer notification. Draft below — feedback pls:
```
Subject: Service degradation notice — Redwood generation API (us-west)
Hi <Customer>,
We experienced elevated latency on our generation API between 06:14–06:28 UTC which may have affected request latency and retries. Our team applied a mitigation and service is stable.
Impact: Increased latency; small number of failed requests.
What we're doing: Root cause analysis and credit eligibility review. We'll follow up with a personalized impact report and any applicable account credits.
Estimated next update: 24 hours.
— Redwood Support
```
Maya (oncall): Lgtm. Add explicit mention of SLA credit process and how customers can request a report.
Lucy (support): Updated template and added instructions.
Billing Bot: Noted — start SLA credit eligibility workflow. Please attach per-account token counts and affected window per customer.
Alex: Action items:
- Sanjay: export logs & token counts (assigned)
- Lucy: send interim notification to all impacted customers and open support tickets (assigned)
- Ryan: create a staging entry for credit calculation (assigned)
- Billing: prepare proforma credit calculations once logs are provided
Sanjay: Logs exported: s3://redwood-incident-exports/1923456789/ — contains request_counts.csv and token_usage.csv
Lucy (support): Sending interim notices now. Will bcc internal cs@redwood so we have records.
Billing Bot: Received logs. Running preliminary credit estimator.
Billing Bot: Estimator results ready — rough credits by account in cents: acct-772: 3200, acct-19: 1800, acct-401: 0 (below threshold). We'll reconcile.
Alex: For customer-facing compensation wording, propose:
"We apologize for the disruption. We will credit impacted accounts proportional to measured degraded request time during the incident window. Credits will appear on your next invoice."
Lucy (support): I'll use that. Also provide a brief FAQ for CS:
- Q: How is credit calculated?
  A: Proportional to affected requests and SLA terms. We compute token-weighted impact and apply percentage per contract.
- Q: Timeline?
  A: Preliminary credit calculation within 48 hours; final after RCA.
Ryan (eng): Noting follow-up: postmortem, metrics, and long-term fix for autoscaler hysteresis.
Alex: Closing notes: monitor for regressions for 2 hours; keep this thread open until billing confirms credits applied. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: Incident resolved -> status: mitigated. Closing the page draft but leaving for final RCA.
Lucy (support): Will post the customer notifications and update tickets. I'll follow up with billing for ledger entries.
Billing Bot: Will file credits to billing queue; tag: incident-1923456789.
Alex: Marking action items done after billing posts adjustments. Great work team.
